correction: The sender read the consent file once at start, so `snosi-health reporting off` returned while the run kept posting. Consent is now read again under /var/lib/snosi-health/.post.lock before each post, and `reporting on|off` waits on the same lock after it writes the file, so no post of that run starts after the decision.
evidence: Cross-review (openai/gpt-6.1-sol) of c69cb30, blocking point 1. test/snosi-health-report-test.sh: the fake intake turns reporting off after the first request; the checks "a run stops when consent is turned off after its first post", "the stopped run records only the 1 post it made" and "the stopped run says reporting was turned off" fail without the fix.
